name: Arcade Games
author: @Art_727 & @lerowplug
summary: 2048, Flappy Bird and Chrome Dino through the existing native Arcade Games bridge.
limitations: Games open in the existing full-screen web view. They require the game site to be reachable. The Android WebView implementation is replaced by the native iOS bridge.
Uses the existing plugin settings and .2048, .flappy and .dino chat commands.
